stanza: Cocaine flame in my bloodstream
Sold my coat when I hit Spokane
Bought myself a hard pack of cigarettes
In the early morning rain
And we just can't have that, girl
'Cause it's a sad, lonesome, cold world
And a man needs a woman
To stand by his side
And whisper sweet words
In his ears about daydreams
And roses and playthings
And the sweetness of springtime
And the sound of the rain

daydream.songTitle: It Might As Well Be Spring
daydream.line: I'm as busy as a spider spinnin' daydreams
stanza: I'm as busy as a spider spinnin' daydreams
I'm as giddy as a baby on a swing
I haven't seen a crocus or a rosebud
Or a robin on the wing
But I feel so gay in a melancholy way
That it might as well be spring
It might as well be spring
Daydreaming (Thinking of you)
Daydreaming (Thinking of you)
Daydreaming
Daydreaming
Day—

daydream.line: But the bamboo hangs heavy in the bondage of quicksilver daydreams
stanza: So the serpent slides slowly away with his moments of laughter
And the old washerwoman has finished her cleanin' and gone
But the bamboo hangs heavy in the bondage of quicksilver daydreams
And a lonely child longingly looks for a place to belong

mainstream.linePrev: I make elevating music, you make elevator music
mainstream.lineNext: Well, that's what they do when they get jealous, they confuse it

moonbeam.line: Have you ever watched a moonbeam
stanza: Have you ever watched a moonbeam
As it slid across your windowpane
Or struggled with a bit of rain
Or danced about the weathervane
Or sat along a moving train
And wondered where the train has been
